binding.source_revision_note: Git commit that contains every bound source input byte-for-byte. The gate validates commit existence, ancestry of the checked-out revision, per-input content equality, and the recorded content digests — a stale revision cannot pass by string reuse.
binding.artifact_commit_note: The commit that introduces this artifact cannot be known when the artifact is generated; left explicitly unclaimed.

dimensions.note: Authority and evidence are SEPARATE dimensions. No entry is 'proven' by its target; privileged-closure-proven requires a structured closure-evidence record. Conditional targets are not counted as current authority.

layers.observed: facts mechanically derived from repository evidence (ontology structure, kernel mappings and declarations, the runtime traversal strategy dispatch, model-resident documentation, and machinery-witnessed evidence for reviewed consumer associations — evidence only, never the association itself)
layers.reviewed: committed governance/migration decisions from docs/method-conformance/o1/authority-review-decisions.yaml (authority classification, targets, evidence state, adoption, gates, dispositions, stages, unknowns, required evidence, reviewed consumer associations) — reviewable metadata, never runtime semantic authority
layers.field_rule: every entry field is attributable to exactly one layer; this generator joins observed+reviewed, validates consistency, and preserves the provenance split

governance_rules.statement: Every Feature shall distinguish at least one member product from another member product.

governance_rules.statement: Every FeatureIncrement shall identify selected SAF viewpoints and out-of-scope viewpoints.

governance_rules.statement: Every Requirement in a feature increment shall trace to at least one Need, RegulatoryConstraint, or ArchitectureDecisionRecord.
governance_rules.enforced_by: scripts/check_model_sync.py sync point 6 resolves each derivation target to its modeled type (including specialization closure) and accepts only targets whose semantic type grounds Need (StakeholderNeedCandidate specializations), RegulatoryConstraint (RegulatoryConstraintCandidate specializations), or ArchitectureDecisionRecord (ArchitectureDecisionRecord specializations); identifier prefixes are never consulted. governance_rules.statement: Every compliance-oriented claim shall be marked as draft, planned, example, verified, or accepted.
